info.prompt: A neon-noir dice puzzle game interface styled as a biological supercomputer, featuring a hexagonal grid of ice-crystal dice with visible numerical faces frozen beneath frosted overlays, suspended in a dark void space crisscrossed by pulsating neural pathways in electric cyan, surrounded by gilded bone-like structural elements engraved with alchemical symbols, and a dynamic multiplier ladder glowing with increasing intensity as it climbs toward x4.
